messages:
leila: hey all, first day! got my MBP and monitor but when i plug the company dock into the laptop the fan spikes and wifi drops for ~10s. happens every time i hot-plug. monitor stays on but system shows 'No Internet'. anyone seen this?
tom_it: welcome Leila! that sounds like the dock is causing a USB/phy reset. which dock model did you get and what's the monitor connection (HDMI/DP via dock or direct)?
leila: Dock label says RD-DK4, monitor connected via DisplayPort over the dock. mac is Ventura 13.5.
nate: quick check: try connecting dock power directly (wall) vs bus-powered. also test with the dock plugged in before booting. if wifi drops only on hot-plug it's likely an IRQ or power surge on the USB bus.
leila: tried powering dock from wall (same adapter) and pre-booted with dock plugged -> fan normal but wifi still drops when i wake from sleep.
tom_it: i'm going to push a driver tweak to the dock firmware and create a ticket. can you also paste the output of `log show --style syslog --last 1h | grep -i airport` after a repro?
leila: pasted logs: "airportd: Wi-Fi disassociated, reason 8" and a few kernel messages about usb2.0_ohci.
it-bot: ticket IT-7022 created and assigned to tom_it. ETA on swap or fix: same day.
courier-bot: spare RD-DK4 (unit B) reserved for pickup at IT desk; ETA 60m for delivery.
nate: if swap doesn't help we'll try a different dock model and, if needed, RMA this dock. for now use ethernet dongle we sent for stable connection (shipping notes say dongle in IT locker).
leila: thanks! swapping dock + using dongle fixed the wifi and fan is quiet. appreciate the speedy help :smile:
